fields.reasoning: Intent: plan-run-stops-open's change set served both milestone-4 and milestone-6; milestone-6 is the open milestone about the daemon running and planning its own PRs unattended, and a plan run that can never resume after the gate stops it is exactly what breaks unattended operation, so milestone-6 is the better single home. Narrowness: internal/api/run.go guards with changeset.State.Terminal(), which covers landed, rejected, withdrawn and superseded. Only landing is expected for a plan run (its record lands during the interview); a rejected, withdrawn or superseded change set still means the owner or the model abandoned the work, and resuming then would ship a dead plan. Keying on the workflow name, which run start --new already checks via planWorkflow, keeps build and review runs protected by the guard as before.
fields.statement: Change set 01M6GCQA serves milestone-6 (Rhiza runs unattended overnight). The exemption in run resume's change-set guard is narrow: a run of the plan workflow (def.Name == planWorkflow) whose change set is landed is let through; every other terminal state (rejected, withdrawn, superseded) still refuses a plan run, and runs of every other workflow keep the guard unchanged
